mechanism: Brimonidine is an alpha-2 adrenergic agonist that may cause CNS depression; bupropion is a norepinephrine-dopamine reuptake inhibitor that increases sympathomimetic activity, creating opposing pharmacodynamic effects.
action: Monitor for changes in mood, blood pressure, and CNS effects; ophthalmic brimonidine has minimal systemic absorption but caution is warranted with sympathomimetic agents.
